text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: Released in 2011, Nintendo 3DS was a handheld console that introduced glasses-free stereoscopic 3D gaming. It featured two screens, including a top display capable of producing depth effects without special glasses, and maintained compatibility with Nintendo DS software. The system received games across many genres, including Mario, Zelda, Pokémon, Animal Crossing, and Monster Hunter titles. The 3DS family became one of Nintendo's most successful handheld platforms with over 75 million systems sold.
